description: pkix-path-builder/src/lib.rs build_path(): The Error::DepthExceeded variant is documented as being returned 'when the path would require more than 10 intermediate certificates' but the function always returns Err(Error::NoPathFound) when no path is found (line 244). The DepthExceeded variant is dead code — it is defined and documented but never constructed or returned. This prevents callers from distinguishing between 'truly no path exists in the pool' and 'path exists but requires more than MAX_DEPTH intermediates.' Fix: after the loop completes without finding a path, determine if there was any candidate issuer beyond depth MAX_DEPTH to distinguish NoPathFound from DepthExceeded.
title: build_path never returns Error::DepthExceeded — dead variant
